title: Benefits from Strategic Food Partnership with New Zealand for Singaporeans and Local Businesses
what_it_is: Benefits from Strategic Food Partnership with New Zealand for Singaporeans and Local Businesses

sections.label: Singapore-New Zealand food partnership
sections.summary: The Strategic Food Partnership with New Zealand aims to strengthen food cooperation in trade, regulations, biosecurity and research, and explores expanding regionalisation for animal diseases.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: The Strategic Food Partnership (SFP) with New Zealand, which was launched in October 2025, aims to strengthen food cooperation between Singapore and New Zealand in areas such as agri-food trade and supply chains, regulations and standards, biosecurity, and research and innovation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: This complements the Agreement on Trade in Essential Supplies, which Singapore has concluded substantive negotiations with New Zealand.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Under the agreement, both sides can continue to receive essential supplies, including food items, during supply chain disruptions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: One initiative we are exploring under the SFP is to expand the existing regionalisation arrangement for Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza to include other significant animal diseases, such as African Swine Fever and Foot and Mouth Disease.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: This would minimise trade disruptions during animal disease outbreaks and can help to maintain consistent food supplies from unaffected regions in New Zealand.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We will also look at ways to facilitate greater food trade.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: These could include facilitating exchanges between both countries' public and private sector stakeholders, such as food and logistics industry players, to identify pain points, and explore solutions and commercialisation and investment opportunities.

sections.label: Global partnership question response
sections.summary: The response says global partnership is an important pillar of Singapore Food Story 2 and encourages the Member to file a separate question or join the Committee of Supply debate.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: As to the first question on global partnership, it is an important pillar of our Singapore Food Story 2.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: I think it fully deserves a better presentation and discussion.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: So, I would encourage the Member to either file a separate Parliamentary Question or to participate fully when we discuss the Singapore Food Story 2 during the Committee of Supply debate.
